name: New Coral City
source:
New Coral City is an adult, choice-driven game where you play as a photographer rebuilding his life and career while getting involved with a growing cast of women, friends, coworkers, and some much more complicated relationships.
As you move through the city, work different photography jobs, attend parties, and meet new people, your choices affect who MC gets close to, who he sleeps with, who he dates, and which storylines remain available.
Characters have their own lives, relationships, personalities, and ongoing stories, so not every path revolves around MC. Some relationships can stay casual, others can become romantic, and some may develop in unexpected directions depending on your previous choices.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/cw/honeygames]Patreon[/url]]

Warning: If you want to play the real "Season 1" you need to play the Prequel "[b]Follower[/b]". Season 2 is just an improved remake of Season 1.
